stories.title: A Small Coffee

sentences.en: Mina is on her way to work.
She has ten minutes before her bus comes.
sentences.tr: Otobüsü gelene kadar on dakikası var.

sentences.en: There is a small cafe near the stop.
sentences.tr: Durağın yakınında küçük bir kafe var.

sentences.en: She asks for a small coffee.
The man at the counter smiles.
Do you want milk with that?
Just a little, please, says Mina.
She pays by card and takes her coffee.
The bus is here, and she is ready.

stories.text: Mina is on her way to work. She has ten minutes before her bus comes. There is a small cafe near the stop. She asks for a small coffee. The man at the counter smiles. Do you want milk with that? Just a little, please, says Mina. She pays by card and takes her coffee. The bus is here, and she is ready.

questions.why: “She pays by card” kartla ödediğini söylüyor.

stories.title: The Spare Key

sentences.en: Ali is at his front door.
His keys are not in his bag.
He looks in his coat, but they are not there.
sentences.tr: Montuna bakıyor ama orada da yoklar.

sentences.en: His sister lives next door.
She has a spare key to his flat.
Ali calls her and waits outside.
Two minutes later, she opens the door.
sentences.tr: İki dakika sonra kardeşi kapıyı açıyor.

sentences.en: His keys are on the kitchen table.
Ali laughs and puts them in his bag.
sentences.tr: Ali gülüyor ve anahtarları çantasına koyuyor.

stories.text: Ali is at his front door. His keys are not in his bag. He looks in his coat, but they are not there. His sister lives next door. She has a spare key to his flat. Ali calls her and waits outside. Two minutes later, she opens the door. His keys are on the kitchen table. Ali laughs and puts them in his bag.

questions.why: Kız kardeşinin evin yedek anahtarı var.

stories.title: At the Corner Shop

sentences.en: Deniz needs some bread and milk.
sentences.tr: Deniz'in ekmek ve süt alması gerekiyor.

sentences.en: The shop on her street is still open.
She takes a bag from the kitchen.
At the shop, she finds the bread.
There is no milk in the fridge.
The woman in the shop brings a new box.
sentences.tr: Marketteki kadın yeni bir kutu getiriyor.

sentences.en: Here you are, she says.
Deniz buys two bottles and goes home.
sentences.tr: Deniz iki şişe alıp eve gidiyor.

sentences.en: Now she can make breakfast.

stories.text: Deniz needs some bread and milk. The shop on her street is still open. She takes a bag from the kitchen. At the shop, she finds the bread. There is no milk in the fridge. The woman in the shop brings a new box. Here you are, she says. Deniz buys two bottles and goes home. Now she can make breakfast.

questions.prompt: Deniz ilk başta ne almak istiyor?
questions.why: İlk cümlede ekmek ve süt gerektiği söyleniyor.
Marketteki kadın yeni bir kutu getiriyor.

stories.title: A New Neighbor

sentences.en: Someone is at the door.
It is a new neighbor with a big box.
sentences.tr: Büyük bir kutu taşıyan yeni komşu gelmiş.

sentences.en: Hi, I am Alex. I live upstairs.
sentences.tr: Merhaba, ben Alex. Üst katta oturuyorum.

sentences.en: Mina smiles and says her name.
Alex asks her about the nearest shop.
sentences.tr: Alex ona en yakın marketi soruyor.

sentences.en: It is next to the cafe, she says.
She offers him a glass of water.
sentences.tr: Ona bir bardak su ikram ediyor.

sentences.en: They talk for a few minutes.
Alex thanks her and carries his box upstairs.
sentences.tr: Alex teşekkür edip kutusunu üst kata taşıyor.

stories.text: Someone is at the door. It is a new neighbor with a big box. Hi, I am Alex. I live upstairs. Mina smiles and says her name. Alex asks her about the nearest shop. It is next to the cafe, she says. She offers him a glass of water. They talk for a few minutes. Alex thanks her and carries his box upstairs.

questions.why: “I live upstairs” üst katta oturuyorum demek.
Mina bir bardak su ikram ediyor.

stories.title: Lunch in the Park

sentences.en: It is one o'clock, and Ali is hungry.
He takes his lunch to the park.
His friend Sam is sitting on a bench.
There is a place next to him.
Ali sits down and opens his bag.
He has a cheese sandwich and an apple.
sentences.tr: Peynirli bir sandviçi ve bir elması var.

sentences.en: Sam has some soup in a cup.
They eat and talk about their day.
sentences.tr: Yemek yiyip günlerinin nasıl geçtiğini konuşuyorlar.

sentences.en: Then they walk back to work together.

stories.text: It is one o'clock, and Ali is hungry. He takes his lunch to the park. His friend Sam is sitting on a bench. There is a place next to him. Ali sits down and opens his bag. He has a cheese sandwich and an apple. Sam has some soup in a cup. They eat and talk about their day. Then they walk back to work together.

options: A cheese sandwich and an apple
questions.why: Çantasından peynirli sandviç ve elma çıkarıyor.
“Back to work” işe geri dönmek demek.

stories.title: A Quiet Evening

sentences.en: It is raining outside.
Deniz is at home with her brother.
He is making tea in the kitchen.
She is looking for a good film.
They do not want to go out tonight.
Her brother brings two cups of tea.
Deniz finds a short, funny film.
sentences.tr: Deniz kısa ve komik bir film buluyor.

sentences.en: They sit on the sofa and watch it.
Sometimes a quiet evening is just right.
sentences.tr: Bazen sakin bir akşam tam da ihtiyacın olan şeydir.

stories.text: It is raining outside. Deniz is at home with her brother. He is making tea in the kitchen. She is looking for a good film. They do not want to go out tonight. Her brother brings two cups of tea. Deniz finds a short, funny film. They sit on the sofa and watch it. Sometimes a quiet evening is just right.

questions.why: Deniz kısa ve komik bir film buluyor.

stories.title: The Bus I Missed

sentences.en: Yesterday, Mina left home a little late.
sentences.tr: Dün Mina evden biraz geç çıktı.

sentences.en: She ran to the bus stop, but the bus was gone.
The next one was in twenty minutes.
She sent a message to her boss.
I am sorry. I missed the bus, she wrote.
sentences.tr: Kusura bakmayın, otobüsü kaçırdım, diye yazdı.

sentences.en: Then she saw a small bakery across the street.
sentences.tr: Sonra sokağın karşısındaki küçük fırını gördü.

sentences.en: She bought a warm roll and a bottle of water.
sentences.tr: Küçük, sıcak bir ekmek ve bir şişe su aldı.

sentences.en: An older woman was also waiting for the bus.
sentences.tr: Yaşlı bir kadın da otobüs bekliyordu.

sentences.en: They talked, and the time passed quickly.
Mina got to work late, but she was not upset.
sentences.tr: Mina işe geç vardı ama canı sıkkın değildi.

stories.text: Yesterday, Mina left home a little late. She ran to the bus stop, but the bus was gone. The next one was in twenty minutes. She sent a message to her boss. I am sorry. I missed the bus, she wrote. Then she saw a small bakery across the street. She bought a warm roll and a bottle of water. An older woman was also waiting for the bus. They talked, and the time passed quickly. Mina got to work late, but she was not upset.

questions.why: “In twenty minutes” yirmi dakika sonra demek.
Durağa gelen yaşlı kadınla sohbet ediyor.

stories.title: My First Day

sentences.en: Ali started a new job on Monday.
sentences.tr: Ali pazartesi yeni bir işe başladı.

sentences.en: He was nervous when he walked into the office.
sentences.tr: Ofise girerken heyecanlı ve biraz gergindi.

sentences.en: A woman called Sara showed him his desk.
sentences.tr: Sara adında bir kadın ona masasını gösterdi.

sentences.en: There was a small plant next to the computer.
sentences.tr: Bilgisayarın yanında küçük bir bitki vardı.

sentences.en: Sara explained the work slowly and answered his questions.
sentences.tr: Sara işi yavaşça anlattı ve sorularını cevapladı.

sentences.en: At lunchtime, she invited him to eat with the team.
sentences.tr: Öğle molasında onu ekiple yemek yemeye çağırdı.

sentences.en: Ali did not know anyone, but everyone was friendly.
sentences.tr: Ali kimseyi tanımıyordu ama herkes sıcak davrandı.

sentences.en: In the afternoon, he finished his first small task.
sentences.tr: Öğleden sonra ilk küçük işini bitirdi.

sentences.en: He still had a lot to learn.
But on the way home, he felt much better.
sentences.tr: Ama eve dönerken kendini çok daha iyi hissediyordu.

stories.text: Ali started a new job on Monday. He was nervous when he walked into the office. A woman called Sara showed him his desk. There was a small plant next to the computer. Sara explained the work slowly and answered his questions. At lunchtime, she invited him to eat with the team. Ali did not know anyone, but everyone was friendly. In the afternoon, he finished his first small task. He still had a lot to learn. But on the way home, he felt much better.

questions.prompt: Ali yeni işine ne zaman başlıyor?

questions.why: Sara işi anlatıp Ali’nin sorularını cevaplıyor.
Son cümlede kendini çok daha iyi hissettiği söyleniyor.

stories.title: One Umbrella

sentences.en: Deniz was walking home when it started to rain.
She looked in her bag for her umbrella.
It was still at home, next to the door.
A neighbor was standing outside the little bookshop.
sentences.tr: Bir komşusu küçük kitapçının önünde duruyordu.

sentences.en: He had a large umbrella and saw Deniz in the rain.
sentences.tr: Büyük bir şemsiyesi vardı; Deniz’i yağmurun altında gördü.

sentences.en: We are going the same way, he said.
They walked together and talked about the neighborhood.
sentences.tr: Birlikte yürüyüp mahalle hakkında sohbet ettiler.

sentences.en: Deniz learned that he had a new puppy.
sentences.tr: Deniz onun yeni bir yavru köpeği olduğunu öğrendi.

sentences.en: They reached their building before the rain got heavier.
The next day, Deniz put the umbrella in her bag.
sentences.tr: Ertesi gün Deniz şemsiyesini çantasına koydu.

stories.text: Deniz was walking home when it started to rain. She looked in her bag for her umbrella. It was still at home, next to the door. A neighbor was standing outside the little bookshop. He had a large umbrella and saw Deniz in the rain. We are going the same way, he said. They walked together and talked about the neighborhood. Deniz learned that he had a new puppy. They reached their building before the rain got heavier. The next day, Deniz put the umbrella in her bag.

questions.why: “A new puppy” yeni bir yavru köpek demek.

stories.title: That Is Not My Lunch

sentences.en: Sam ordered a chicken sandwich at a busy cafe.
sentences.tr: Sam kalabalık bir kafede tavuklu sandviç söyledi.

sentences.en: When his food arrived, it was a cheese sandwich.
sentences.tr: Yemek geldiğinde peynirli sandviç olduğunu gördü.

sentences.en: He checked the menu and then called the waiter.
Excuse me, I ordered the chicken sandwich, he said.
The waiter looked at the plate and apologized.
sentences.tr: Garson tabağa baktı ve özür diledi.

sentences.en: He took it back and brought the right sandwich.
sentences.tr: Onu geri götürüp doğru sandviçi getirdi.

sentences.en: He also brought a glass of water.
Sam thanked him and enjoyed his lunch.
Sam felt better after the conversation.
sentences.tr: Sam konuşmadan sonra kendini daha iyi hissetti.

sentences.en: It was a small mistake, and his food was good.
sentences.tr: Küçük bir hataydı; yemeği de güzeldi.

stories.text: Sam ordered a chicken sandwich at a busy cafe. When his food arrived, it was a cheese sandwich. He checked the menu and then called the waiter. Excuse me, I ordered the chicken sandwich, he said. The waiter looked at the plate and apologized. He took it back and brought the right sandwich. He also brought a glass of water. Sam thanked him and enjoyed his lunch. Sam felt better after the conversation. It was a small mistake, and his food was good.

questions.why: Garson bir bardak su da getiriyor.

stories.title: A Different Saturday

sentences.en: Mina and Ali planned to have a picnic on Saturday.
sentences.tr: Mina ve Ali cumartesi piknik yapmayı planladı.

sentences.en: They bought bread, cheese, tomatoes, and some fruit.
sentences.tr: Ekmek, peynir, domates ve biraz meyve aldılar.

sentences.en: On Saturday morning, the sky was dark.
Then it started to rain, so they changed their plan.
sentences.tr: Sonra yağmur başladı; onlar da planı değiştirdi.

sentences.en: We can have our picnic here, said Ali.
They put a blanket on the living room floor.
Mina opened the window to hear the rain.
sentences.tr: Mina yağmurun sesini duymak için pencereyi açtı.

sentences.en: They ate their food and played a simple game.
sentences.tr: Yemeklerini yiyip basit bir oyun oynadılar.

sentences.en: The day was different, but it was still fun.
sentences.tr: Gün farklı geçti ama yine de eğlenceliydi.

sentences.en: But they had a good time anyway.
sentences.tr: Ama yine de güzel vakit geçirdiler.

stories.text: Mina and Ali planned to have a picnic on Saturday. They bought bread, cheese, tomatoes, and some fruit. On Saturday morning, the sky was dark. Then it started to rain, so they changed their plan. We can have our picnic here, said Ali. They put a blanket on the living room floor. Mina opened the window to hear the rain. They ate their food and played a simple game. The day was different, but it was still fun. But they had a good time anyway.

questions.why: Örtüyü salonun zeminine serip orada yemek yiyorlar.

stories.title: A Call Before Dinner

sentences.en: Deniz called her friend before she started cooking.
sentences.tr: Deniz yemek yapmaya başlamadan arkadaşını aradı.

sentences.en: They last met a few weeks ago.
sentences.tr: En son birkaç hafta önce görüşmüşlerdi.

sentences.en: Her friend was moving to a new flat nearby.
sentences.tr: Arkadaşı yakındaki yeni bir eve taşınıyordu.

sentences.en: The kitchen was full of boxes, so she could not cook.
Come over for dinner, said Deniz.
I am making soup, and there is enough for two.
Her friend arrived with some bread from the bakery.
They ate at the small kitchen table.
After dinner, they made a plan to move the boxes.
sentences.tr: Yemekten sonra kutuları taşımak için plan yaptılar.

sentences.en: Sometimes helping a friend starts with a simple phone call.
sentences.tr: Bazen bir arkadaşına yardım etmek basit bir telefonla başlar.

stories.text: Deniz called her friend before she started cooking. They last met a few weeks ago. Her friend was moving to a new flat nearby. The kitchen was full of boxes, so she could not cook. Come over for dinner, said Deniz. I am making soup, and there is enough for two. Her friend arrived with some bread from the bakery. They ate at the small kitchen table. After dinner, they made a plan to move the boxes. Sometimes helping a friend starts with a simple phone call.
